snippet.title: BWF TV
snippet.description:
BWF TV is the official live channel of the Badminton World Federation (BWF), where we bring to you live, catch-up and delayed streaming of the major events on our calendar such as the HSBC BWF World Tour and the TotalEnergies BWF World Championships.

On this channel we will bring the badminton community the most current news, highlights, features and information. We upload every week and daily throughout a tournament so subscribe to ensure you don’t miss out! http://smarturl.it/BWFsubscribe 
    
BWF TV helps fans connect and share their love of badminton and aims to bring the sport onto a global stage.

snippet.title: Badminton Asia
snippet.description:
Badminton Asia is the governing body of the badminton sport in Asia under the flagship of Badminton World Federation (BWF). Badminton Asia is currently represented by 43 member associations from 5 sub-regions all across Asia.

http://badmintonasia.org/

snippet.title: Badminton Oceania
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Badminton Oceania.

We are the continental governing body for badminton across Oceania, represented by 18 member associations and working under the flagship of Badminton World Federation.

Here you'll find tournament coverage, athlete stories, and tips for players. 

Subscribe to follow our players, catch up on competitions, and stay connected with badminton across Oceania.

📍 Follow us:
Instagram: @Badmintonoceania
Facebook: @BOC.badminton
Website: badmintonoceania.org
